title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ProcessSpecification
description: ProcessSpecification is a class that allow to describe a process design. A process instance will use a ProcessSpecification as reference. (TM Forum TMF701 Process Management 5.0.0, OpenAPI component ProcessSpecification; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:ProcessSpecification:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ProcessSpecification'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'ProcessSpecification' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Addressable/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:ProcessSpecification:<tmfId>. unique identifier

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProcessSpecification/properties/description'. Description of the process specification

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProcessSpecification/properties/lastUpdate'. Date and time of the last update of the process specification

processSpecificationPolicy.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProcessSpecification/properties/processSpecificationPolicy'. A list of policies related to this process specification to dynamically reference and comply with predefined policies, for example for approval process, onboarding process or eligibility check tasks.

lifecycleStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProcessSpecification/properties/lifecycleStatus'. Used to indicate the current lifecycle status of this process specification, for example: draft, underReview, inProduction, released, deprecated

validFor.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProcessSpecification/properties/validFor'. A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

attachment.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProcessSpecification/properties/attachment'. Attachments that are of relevance to this process specification, such as picture, document, media. This could be for example a how-to or a faq to explain this process specification

taskSpecification.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProcessSpecification/properties/taskSpecification'. A list of task specifications that define the tasks that can potentially be instantiated within a process that is instantiated from this process specification. In TMF this is an array of TaskSpecificationRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced TaskSpecification entities (urn:ngsi-ld:TaskSpecification:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

channel.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProcessSpecification/properties/channel'. A list of channels where Processes instantiated from this ProcessSpecification could be executed

processSpecificationCharacteristic.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProcessSpecification/properties/processSpecificationCharacteristic'. List of characteristics that the process specification can take

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProcessSpecification/properties/relatedParty'. Parties who manage or otherwise have an interest in this process Specification

processSpecificationRelationship.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProcessSpecification/properties/processSpecificationRelationship'. A list of design-time policy links from the current ProcessSpecification to other ProcessSpecifications, declaring which instance-level relationships are permitted or expected via relationshipType (e.g., Trigger/BeTriggeredBy, DelegateTo/BeDelegatedBy, DependOn/RequiredBy).

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF701_ProcessFlow/blob/v5.0.0/TMF701-Process_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProcessSpecification/properties/name'. Name given to the process specification

Attachment.description: Complements the description of an element (for instance a product) through video, pictures...

description.description: A narrative text describing the content of the attachment

url.description: The URL pointing to the attachment content held in an external system, such as a content management system or document repository. Mutually exclusive with content.

content.description: The actual contents of the attachment object, embedded inline and encoded as base64. Mutually exclusive with url.

attachmentType.description: a business characterization of the purpose of the attachment, for example logo, instructionManual, contractCopy

mimeType.description: A technical characterization of the attachment content format using an IETF Media Type, for example application/pdf or image/png. Note: this property is named mimeType for historical reasons.

AttachmentRef.description: Attachment reference. An attachment complements the description of an element (for instance a product) through video, pictures

AttachmentRefOrValue.description: The polymorphic attributes @type, @schemaLocation & @referredType are related to the Attachment entity and not the AttachmentRefOrValue class itself

ChannelRef.description: The channel to which the resource reference to. e.g. channel for selling product offerings, channel for opening a trouble ticket etc..

CharacteristicSpecification.description: This class defines a characteristic specification.

name.description: A word, term, or phrase by which this characteristic specification is known and distinguished from other characteristic specifications.

valueType.description: A kind of value that the characteristic can take on, such as numeric, text and so forth

description.description: A narrative that explains the CharacteristicSpecification.

configurable.description: If true, the Boolean indicates that the target Characteristic is configurable

minCardinality.description: The minimum number of instances a CharacteristicValue can take on. For example, zero to five phone numbers in a group calling plan, where zero is the value for the minCardinality.

maxCardinality.description: The maximum number of instances a CharacteristicValue can take on. For example, zero to five phone numbers in a group calling plan, where five is the value for the maxCardinality.

isUnique.description: Specifies if the value of this characteristic is unique across all entities instantiated from the specification that uses this characteristic. For example, consider a ProductSpecification for a set-top box, with a CharacteristicSpecification cardID. Each set-top box must have a different value for cardID, so this isUnique attribute would be set to true for the characteristic.

regex.description: A rule or principle represented in regular expression used to derive the value of a characteristic value.

extensible.description: An indicator that specifies that the values for the characteristic can be extended by adding new values when instantiating a characteristic for a resource.

@valueSchemaLocation.description: This (optional) field provides a link to the schema describing the value type.

charSpecRelationship.description: An aggregation, migration, substitution, dependency or exclusivity relationship between/among Specification Characteristics.

characteristicValueSpecification.description: A CharacteristicValueSpecification object is used to define a set of attributes, each of which can be assigned to a corresponding set of attributes in a CharacteristicSpecification object. The values of the attributes in the CharacteristicValueSpecification object describe the values of the attributes that a corresponding Characteristic object can take on.

CharacteristicSpecificationRelationship.description: An aggregation, migration, substitution, dependency or exclusivity relationship between/among Characteristic specifications. The specification characteristic is embedded within the specification whose ID and href are in this entity, and identified by its ID.

relationshipType.description: Type of relationship such as aggregation, migration, substitution, dependency, exclusivity

name.description: Name of the target characteristic within the specification

characteristicSpecificationId.description: Unique identifier of the characteristic within the specification

parentSpecificationHref.description: Hyperlink reference to the parent specification containing the target characteristic

parentSpecificationId.description: Unique identifier of the parent specification containing the target characteristic

CharacteristicValueSpecification.description: specification of a value (number or text or an object) that can be assigned to a Characteristic. This is an abstract base class, the actual value is in one of the strongly-typed subclasses : BooleanArrayCharacteristicValueSpecification, BooleanCharacteristicValueSpecification, FloatArrayCharacteristicValueSpecification, FloatCharacteristicValueSpecification, IntegerArrayCharacteristicValueSpecification, IntegerCharacteristicValueSpecification, MapArrayCharacteristicValueSpecification, MapCharacteristicValueSpecification, NumberArrayCharacteristicValueSpecification, NumberCharacteristicValueSpecification, ObjectArrayCharacteristicValueSpecification, ObjectCharacteristicValueSpecification, StringArrayCharacteristicValueSpecification, StringCharacteristicValueSpecification...

valueType.description: A kind of value that the characteristic value can take on, such as numeric, text and so forth

isDefault.description: If true, the Boolean Indicates if the value is the default value for a characteristic

unitOfMeasure.description: A length, surface, volume, dry measure, liquid measure, money, weight, time, and the like. In general, a determinate quantity or magnitude of the kind designated, taken as a standard of comparison for others of the same kind, in assigning to them numerical values, as 1 foot, 1 yard, 1 mile, 1 square foot.

valueFrom.description: The low range value that a characteristic can take on

valueTo.description: The upper range value that a characteristic can take on

rangeInterval.description: An indicator that specifies the inclusion or exclusion of the valueFrom and valueTo attributes. If applicable, possible values are "open", "closed", "closedBottom" and "closedTop".

regex.description: A regular expression constraint for given value

modality.description: modality of use of this characteristic specification

PartyRoleRef.description: Party role reference. A party role represents the part played by a party in a given context.

partyId.description: The identifier of the engaged party that is linked to the PartyRole object.

partyName.description: The name of the engaged party that is linked to the PartyRole object.

version.description: The version of the referred process specification.

ProcessSpecificationRelationship.description: A relationship (triggers, delegates, etc...) between/among process specifications.

relationshipType.description: Type of relationship such as triggers, delegates, etc.

Quantity.description: An amount in a given unit

amount.description: Numeric value in a given unit

RelatedPartyRefOrPartyRoleRef.description: RelatedParty reference. A related party defines party or party role or its reference, linked to a specific entity

role.description: Role played by the related party or party role in the context of the specific entity it is linked to. Such as 'initiator', 'customer', 'salesAgent', 'user'
